content:
alex: Heads-up — bringing up Lagrange-13B (int4) on dedicated pool. Seeing intermittent OOMs under our standard batching defaults when max_new_tokens hits ~1k.
maya: Can you paste the error log? is it frag or a big alloc? :thinking_face: 
simon: Curious if this is the model's activation memory pattern or our KV cache sizing. Lagrange has larger kv-per-token from the aten kernels.
alex: quick logs: 
```
OOM on GPU0: alloc failed, requested 14.2GB, available 12.3GB
stack: runtime/infer::allocate -> attention_kv_cache::reserve
context: batch=6, seq_len=1024, kv_shards=1
```
eva: That's consistent with fragmentation + single-shard KV. If a few requests have long contexts we blow past reserved contig space.
pranay: What are current batching presets? max_batch_size and max_tokens_per_batch?
alex: defaults we used (same as 13B):
```
{"max_batch_size": 8, "max_tokens_per_batch": 8192, "max_new_tokens_default": 1024, "prefetch_window": 5, "kv_shard_count": 1}
```
toni: Two quick levers: drop max_new_tokens default to 512; reduce prefetch_window to 2; enable kv_shard_count=2 to reduce large contiguous KV allocations. Also try `max_tokens_per_batch` -> 4096.
maya: Agree. Also try continuous-batching backoff on 95th-percentile latency so we don't accumulate too many in-flight long-context requests.
simon: One more thought — quantization: are we using per-channel int4 or symmetric? int4 per-tensor might increase transient memory. How was Lagrange quant'd?
alex: We used quant-mode `q-pcol-4` (per-channel) via our quant pipeline. We did a quick eval suite: slight perplexity delta but generation quality looked similar on small samples.
eva: Noted a small but reproducible drop on long-context summarization eval: Rouge-L down ~1.8 points when we forced `max_new_tokens=1024`. Might be related to tokenization + streaming truncation.
pranay: Proposal for a short experiment matrix:
- A: defaults -> max_new_tokens=1024, kv_shard=1, prefetch=5
- B: conservative -> max_new_tokens=512, kv_shard=2, prefetch=2, max_tokens_per_batch=4096
- C: aggressive batching -> max_batch_size=12 but token cap=4096, backoff at p95 latency
We run each on canary (10% traffic) for 2h and collect OOMs, p95 latency, and rouge on canned prompts.
toni: + add memory fragmentation metric from `nvml_frag` and record `free_contig_bytes` sample. We want to see contig vs total free.
alex: launching B now against dedicated-staging-2. I'll roll to 10% Canary if stable for 15m.
infra-bot: deploy/rollout started: lagrange-13b-int4 -> staging -> pool:d-staging-2 -> canary=10% (triggered by alex)
simon: If B fixes OOMs but hurts quality, we can try hybrid: kv_shard=2 but bump max_new_tokens to 768 and see tradeoff.
maya: Also capture model outputs for the failing prompts at both settings — need diffs to see whether quality loss is from quantization or truncation.
eva: Running eval harness now on 200 long-doc summarization samples. ETA ~18m.
alex: quick note — if kv_shard increase reduces contig allocations but increases total mem overhead, ensure we stay under GPU reservation for Dedicated. We may need to increase reserved per-GPU budget by 1-2GB in the pool config.
pranay: Good catch. We'll measure reserved_pool_memory before changing.
infra-bot: monitor/alert: OOM count on pool:d-staging-2 decreased from 7 -> 0 in last 30m after B rollout.
alex: Good news. eva: eval results: B vs A on 200 samples: Rouge-L delta = -0.9 (B worse), but p95 latency improved 22%, OOMs -> 0.
simon: delta -0.9 is acceptable for initial canary. We can try hybrid 768 as suggested for a middle ground.
maya: Also test switching to sparse prefetch: `prefetch_mode: heuristic` which only prefetch for short requests. Might reduce long tail frag.
toni: Next steps:
- Run hybrid (kv_shard=2, max_new_tokens=768, prefetch=3) for 2h canary
- Collect nvml_frag, p95, OOMs, and rouge on the same sample set
- If hybrid keeps OOMs at 0 and rouge delta <= -0.5, promote to 50%
alex: I'll run hybrid at 14:10 PST. tagging folks who want quick look: @maya @simon @eva
pranay: I'll prepare the config patch and the Prometheus dashboards for the new metrics.
alex: Thanks team. Will post final numbers after hybrid run. :thumbsup:
